entity_name: AJPES main portal and Katalog informacij javnega značaja
source_name: AJPES – Bonitete / FI=PO Finančni pomočnik and S.BON credit-rating products
why_relevant: AJPES value-added layer over the same filings: benchmarking ratios, sector aggregates and S.BON scores. Useful for placing a Slovenian PSP or ATM operator against its SKD-sector peer distribution without rebuilding the ratio maths, and for spotting financially stressed independent deployers.

source_name: Bizi.si – company financial profiles and retail-sector rankings
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator of AJPES data that publishes ready-made 'largest Slovenian retailers' comparisons; far cheaper to monitor than filing-by-filing AJPES work, and its editorial pieces are a reliable annual pointer to who the top merchant counterparties are.

source_name: Računalniške novice — recurring coverage of SI payment-habits research
why_relevant: SI tech-business outlet that reliably republishes vendor and agency payment-habit survey findings (Masterindex waves, contactless and mobile-payment adoption percentages). Practical capture channel for study results whose originals sit behind vendor PR, not a primary source.

source_name: Addiko Bank Slovenija (addiko.si) — card and payment product/tariff pages
why_relevant: The Slovenian subsidiary publishes no local annual report on its site (searches returned only product pages), so its card range, payment-services timetable (urnik placilnih storitev) and tariff documents are the only local-language disclosure of scheme mix, pricing and payment cut-offs. Useful for competitive card-pricing tracking rather than volumes.
Small aggregator that indexes by employer name, convenient for monitoring named actors (Banka Slovenije, NLB, Bankart, Halcom) with a single URL pattern per employer.
Smaller domestic bank; its vacancies indicate whether second-tier banks are insourcing or outsourcing card/payment operations, a useful contrast signal to NLB/Bankart activity.

source_name: GVIN.com – Slovenian business intelligence and financial analysis database
why_relevant: Higher-end commercial layer over Slovenian company and financial data with multi-year analysis packages (reported tiers c. EUR 1,505 / 1,999 / 2,800 + VAT annually). Relevant if the project needs multi-year peer analytics for PSPs and terminal/ATM service firms without building the ratio pipeline in-house.

Second Slovenian aggregator/alerting service covering national and EU notices; cross-checking two aggregators plus the official portal reduces the chance of missing an award notice with idiosyncratic wording (e.g. 'samopostrežne naprave' instead of 'bankomati').

source_name: KPMG in Slovenia (kpmg.com/si) — financial services practice & insights
why_relevant: KPMG SI names financial services as a key segment; the local site is the pointer to any SI banking survey or CEE report localisation. No SI-specific banking report surfaced in search, so this is a watch-point rather than a proven data source.

Commercial aggregator with a dedicated banking/finance category; useful as a cross-check against ESS and as an actor-discovery channel (vendors, integrators and outsourcers hiring for Slovenian bank projects).
Second major commercial aggregator; different employer mix than Optius, so combining the two reduces the chance of missing a bank/processor hiring wave.
